requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each ESA sample (lamps, parking sensors, radar if supplied) for a legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present.

requirements.text: In case an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a designated Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check documentation for an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report on non-interchangeability; pass if one is present.

requirements.text: ESAs which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
requirements.test_case: Verify that installation guidelines are supplied with the radar ESA; pass if guidelines covering installation are provided.

requirements.text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
requirements.test_case: Review ESA test reports against paragraph 6 (and 7 if applicable) requirements; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each approved ESA for an affixed approval mark per paragraph 5.3; pass if present (or ESA is part of a vehicle approved as a unit).

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark for a circle enclosing 'E' and the country number; pass if correct.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number to the right of the circle; pass if correct.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review design and EMC test results of the bumper ESAs installed in the vehicle; pass if the vehicle complies in normal use.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify test reports cover radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity for each ESA; pass if all four are tested and passed.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type (LED lamps/control gear, ultrasonic parking sensors, and radar if supplied) shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 for each ESA.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 30-75 MHz; pass if below the logarithmically decreasing 62-52 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 75-400 MHz; pass if below the 52-63 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured broadband values with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all are below.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms narrowband radiated emission measurement per Annex 8.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 in 30-75 MHz; pass if below the 52-42 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 in 75-400 MHz; pass if below the 42-53 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Check the report confirms ISO 7637-2 transient emission testing per Annex 10.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure positive transient pulses per ISO 7637-2; pass if amplitude ≤ +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the report confirms radiated immunity testing using Annex 9 method(s).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied test levels against Tables 2a and 2b in the report.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range, and at 10 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
requirements.test_case: If ALSE is used, verify fields of 30/25 V/m (80-2,000 MHz) and 10/8 V/m (2-6 GHz) with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
requirements.test_case: If stripline is used, verify field ≥60 V/m over >90% and ≥50 V/m over all of 20-400 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
requirements.test_case: If TEM cell is used, verify field ≥75 V/m over >90% and ≥62.5 V/m over all of 20-200 MHz.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range and at a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
requirements.test_case: If BCI is used, verify current ≥60 mA over >90% and ≥50 mA over all of 20-400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range, and at 7 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 6 V/m over the whole of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber is used, verify fields of 21/18 V/m (LUF-2,000 MHz) and 7/6 V/m (2-6 GHz).

requirements.text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review circuit documentation; if no oscillator >9 kHz, narrowband test may be waived.

requirements.text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Monitor lamp output and sensor functions during Annex 9 testing; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the report confirms ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 immunity testing per Annex 10.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify starting-profile results are classified per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify pulse results are classified using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at specified level for 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III achieved.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if required functional status class is reached.

requirements.text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review function analysis; if no immunity related functions, radiated immunity test may be waived.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review design; if criteria met, transient emission test may be waived.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions from 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth; pass if all values are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the broadband radiated emission test report and confirm the test was performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: During the radiated broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report that the LED lamps and parking sensors were operated in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during measurement.

requirements.text: For an ESA other than one involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report documents the ALSE method per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 for the bumper ESAs.

requirements.text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if ambient is at least 6 dB below the limits (excluding intentional narrowband transmissions).

requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits for the ESA apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the measured emissions cover 30 to 1,000 MHz and stay below the applicable limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurement of the ESA, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report that a 20 dB correction factor was applied when peak detection was used.

requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
requirements.test_case: Review instrument settings in the report against Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the test setup in the report matches the CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 ALSE arrangement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify that the ESA emissions measured from 30 to 1,000 MHz are below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 narrowband limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements of the ESA shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the receiver settings in the report and confirm the average detector was used.

requirements.text: The ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11) only provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm that the chosen combination of ISO 11452 methods covers the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: For the immunity testing of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms that the frequency range and general test conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions of the ESA during the immunity tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm during the test that the lamps and sensors are powered and operating in normal mode (e.g. indicator flashing, fog lamp lit, sensors measuring).

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up against the arrangement defined in Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available as interconnecting cables, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
requirements.test_case: Measure the harness length between the ECU and the AN in the set-up and compare it with the length specified in the ISO standard.

requirements.text: The immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms coverage of 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 20 to 400 MHz range are AM, 1 kHz, 80 % depth.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz range are PM with Ton 3 µs and a period of 3,333 µs.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the generator settings in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz ranges are PM with Ton 500 µs and a period of 1,000 µs.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the step size and dwell time in the test report comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test of the ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, or alternatively, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, at a reduced number of spot frequencies chosen by the Technical Service to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report for the full-range intervals, or for accredited full-band data plus spot-frequency confirmation tests.

requirements.text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.test_case: In case of a failure, check field monitoring records to confirm that the failure occurred under the specified field conditions.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the absorber chamber test report that the field was established by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the antenna polarization recorded in the test report is vertical.

requirements.text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3, and depending on the ESA to be tested the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell shall be chosen.
requirements.test_case: Check that the TEM cell test report references ISO 11452-3 and documents the chosen maximum coupling orientation.

requirements.text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, or alternatively with the ESA installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI method and measure the probe distance (150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed loop) in the set-up.

requirements.text: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the stripline test report references and follows ISO 11452-5.

requirements.text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the reverberation chamber test report references and follows ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 10 transient immunity tests on each ESA (LED lamps, parking sensors) and confirm that the required functional status is met.

requirements.text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Measure the conducted transient emissions of each ESA on its supply lines and confirm they are within the limits.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESAs as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the supply lines and connected lines of the ESA and verify the required FPSC is achieved.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the ESAs as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines; ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines of the ESA and verify the required functional status class is met.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure the transient emissions of the ESA per ISO 7637-2 on its supply lines and confirm compliance with the Regulation limits.

requirements.text: The external surface of the vehicle (front bumper assembly, including fascia, grille, emblem, plate holder and towing eye cover) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed bumper external surface; pass if no outward-directed pointed, sharp or injurious projections are found.

requirements.text: The external surface of the vehicle (front bumper assembly) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed bumper for outward-directed hooks, edges or parts that could catch; pass if none are present.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface of the front bumper assembly shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure radii of curvature of all protruding parts with radius gauges; pass if every radius is at least 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: For parts of the external surface of the front bumper assembly which protrude less than 5 mm, the 2.5 mm radius requirement shall not apply, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure protrusion of small features; for those protruding 1.5 mm to <5 mm verify outward facing angles are blunted.

requirements.text: Where protruding parts of the external surface of the front bumper assembly are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A and have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, the hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure Shore A hardness on the installed component; pass if hardness ≤60 Shore A for parts with radius below 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Added ornaments (e.g. the radome emblem) which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 daN at the most salient point parallel to the mounting surface; pass if the ornament retracts, detaches or bends over.

requirements.text: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: After the 10 daN test, measure the remaining projection; pass if it is 10 mm or less.

requirements.text: The projections remaining after the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the residual projections after the test; pass if no pointed, sharp or injurious parts remain.

requirements.text: For ornaments on radiator grilles, only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
requirements.test_case: Verify the grille-mounted emblem against paragraph 5 radius and projection requirements.

requirements.text: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface of the front bumper assembly shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the attachment of protective strips by manual pull; pass if they are firmly secured.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.test_case: Measure distances between consecutive lower grille elements; verify ≤40 mm and functional purpose where the 2.5 mm radius exemption is used.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm between consecutive elements of grilles and gaps, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.test_case: For grille gaps between 25 and 40 mm, measure element radii; pass if ≥1 mm.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: For grille gaps ≤25 mm, measure external face radii; pass if ≥0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify gap distances were measured using the Annex 3 paragraph 4 method.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each grille element edge between front and side faces; pass if blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.test_case: Inspect bumper ends; pass if they turn in towards the body surface.

requirements.text: The bumper end requirement is considered satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check bumper integration in bodywork, or verify with a 100 mm sphere that the end is not contactable and measure the end gap ≤20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, this applying to that part of the zone situated between and in front of the tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.test_case: Measure radii of the rigid surface within 20 mm inward of the contour line in the ±15° zone per Fig. 1; pass if all radii ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.test_case: Measure radii of the rigid bumper surface outside the 5 mm zone; pass if all radii ≥ 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Parts on or of the bumper or bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, are exempt from paragraph 6.5.2., but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Identify bumper parts/insets projecting less than 5 mm (e.g. sensors, joint covers) and check that outward facing angles are blunted where projection ≥ 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. does not apply to the bumper cover; the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable to the bumper cover.
requirements.test_case: Assess the bumper cover (fascia) against the general requirements of paragraph 5 (radii and projections); pass if all paragraph 5 requirements are met.

requirements.text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.test_case: Fit a registration plate per manufacturer recommendation, probe the plate holder with a 100 mm sphere; where contactable, verify paragraph 5.4 radius requirements are met.

requirements.text: If the dimension of the projection of a component mounted on a surface other than convex (e.g. emblem, plate holder, towing eye cover, sensors) cannot be determined by simple measurement, it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component.
requirements.test_case: Roll a 100 mm sphere over the mounted component in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere centre from the nominal panel line as the projection.

requirements.text: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille (e.g. the lower grille and air intake) shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact.
requirements.test_case: Place the sphere in the lower grille openings and measure the distance between the two perpendicular planes through its contact points to obtain the gap dimension.

requirements.text: The vehicle fitted with the front protective device shall be subjected to impact tests made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation and, after each impact test, shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 6.1.1. to 6.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform the low-speed impact tests per Annex 3 on the vehicle with the bumper fitted and check all paragraph 6.1.1-6.1.5 criteria after each impact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, operate the integrated front fog lamps and direction indicators and verify they function correctly and remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications only provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
requirements.test_case: If fog lamp aim is disturbed after impact, verify it can be restored to specification using only the normal adjustment means.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, open and close the bonnet, boot lid and doors and verify normal operation.

requirements.text: The side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact made in accordance with annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Observe during and after each impact that no side door opens.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect fuel and cooling systems behind the bumper for leaks and constrictions and verify normal functioning.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, operate fuel and coolant caps/sealing devices and verify normal operation.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the exhaust system for damage or displacement impairing its function.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, check alignment/adjustment and normal operation of propulsion, suspension, tyres, steering and brakes.

requirements.text: Sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems (e.g. the front radar and ultrasonic parking sensors) may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 only as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, if radar/parking sensors are damaged or misaligned, verify basic braking and steering performance remain intact.

requirements.text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.test_case: Measure the protective device height at unladen and laden weight and confirm the horizontal plane at the reference height intersects it between the corners.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.test_case: Use high-speed video or contact marks to confirm the impactor contour first touches the front protective device and no other part.

requirements.text: The reference height of the impactor reference line is 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor reference line above the ground; it must be 445 mm.

requirements.text: The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the front surface of the vehicle, one impact made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other made with the vehicle under "laden test weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report shows two frontal longitudinal impacts, one at unladen weight and one at laden test weight.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impacts on the front surface, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral offset between the two impact locations (at least 300 mm) and confirm both lie within the corner planes.

requirements.text: In the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
requirements.test_case: Record the impact speed with the speed instrument; it must be between 4.00 and 4.25 km/h.

requirements.text: The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner of the vehicle at unladen weight (see paragraph 3.1.3. of the Regulation) and an impact at the other front corner with the vehicle at the weight given in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows one front-corner impact at unladen weight and the other front-corner impact at laden test weight.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between plane A and the vehicle median plane; it must be within 55° to 65°.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the offset of the first contact point from the impactor's vertical median plane; it must be no more than 25 mm.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
requirements.test_case: Record the corner impact speed; it must be between 2.5 and 2.6 km/h.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices (front fog lamps and front direction indicators) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp mountings in the bumper after vibration/normal use and confirm position, orientation and photometry remain within the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the front fog lamps and front direction indicator lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Check that lamp fixing and any aiming device in the bumper cannot be moved without deliberate action or tools.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraph 2.5.10. (front fog lamps) shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the front fog lamp aim can be easily adjusted with the bumper fitted.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices (front direction indicators), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed direction indicator reference axis relative to the ground plane; deviation shall not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: For light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps (front direction indicators), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed direction indicator reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; deviation shall not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare lamp installation in the bumper with the manufacturer's fitting instructions; all instructions shall be met.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, in each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the orientation of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Confirm measured angular deviations of the reference axis in each direction are within ±3°.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp heights and orientation on the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and record compliance.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair (front fog lamps, front direction indicators) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface).
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral positions of left and right lamps from the median longitudinal plane; they shall be symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare exterior form of left and right lamps; they shall be mirror-symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Check approval/colour of left and right lamps of each pair; both shall meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric approval data of left and right lamps of each pair; they shall be substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect front lamps for logos; count shall be two lateral or one central at most.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logos in lamps; only vehicle or body manufacturer logos shall be present.

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: For each grouped/combined lamp verify colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical connection requirements of every function.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions switched OFF; values shall comply.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (front fog lamps) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of the front fog lamp apparent surface from the rear per paragraph 5.10.4.2.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp heights from the highest and lowest points of the apparent surface and compare with the limits.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp and verify that intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON (apart from permitted variations).

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify that the front direction-indicator lamps flash.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the front fog lamps or front direction-indicator lamps vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Check that any designed variation of lamp output stays within the device approval photometric limits.

requirements.text: If the photometric characteristics of the front direction indicator lamp of category 1, 1a or 1b are varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources, this shall be as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6 or paragraph 5.6.11. of UN Regulation No. [LSD].
requirements.test_case: Verify the sequential activation pattern conforms to R6 para. 5.6 / LSD para. 5.6.11 via the device approval report.

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp (front fog lamp) if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observe from Zone 2 at 25 m behind the vehicle; no direct view of the white fog lamp apparent surface shall be possible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. (front and rear position lamps, end-outline marker lamps if they exist, side-marker lamps if they exist, and rear registration plate lamp) are also switched ON.
requirements.test_case: With position lamps OFF, attempt to switch ON the front fog lamps; they shall not illuminate.

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, their electrical connections shall be such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of a substituting fog lamp and verify the front position lamps switch ON automatically.

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5.
requirements.test_case: Verify the fog lamp installed meets front position lamp geometric visibility angles of paragraph 6.9.5.

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution.
requirements.test_case: Check fog lamp photometry meets front position lamp minimum values at the light distribution angles.

requirements.text: The concealment of the front direction-indicator lamps shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the front direction indicators are not concealable.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps may be concealed only when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Verify any concealment of fog lamps occurs only when they are switched OFF.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamps shall be white or selective yellow.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the fog lamp light and verify it is within white or selective yellow limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the direction-indicator lamps shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the indicator light and verify it is within amber limits.

requirements.text: The number of front fog lamps and front direction-indicator lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count installed fog lamps and front indicators and compare with paragraphs 6.3 and 6.5.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamps shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Place each movable component in its fixed positions and verify ≤ 50 % of the indicator apparent surface is hidden.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s), shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Replace the light source in the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools and confirm correct replacement without expert assistance.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, it shall be demonstrated to the Technical Service that the electric power supply conditions for the lamps comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle, with the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals with the vehicle electrical system in constant voltage operating condition and compare with 5.27.1/5.27.2 limits.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle and confirm it does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp terminal voltage in constant voltage condition; pass if not above nominal value (e.g. 13.5 V) +3 %.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed bumper (fascia, bezels, grille) that no part obstructs light from the apparent surface within the required geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If measurements of geometric visibility are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the geometric visibility measurement procedure uses parallel-shifted observation directions when measured near the lamp.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure the lamp with the obstructing bumper parts in place and verify the device photometric values are met.

requirements.text: The photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal only when the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height per 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometry down to 5° below horizontal is met.

requirements.text: A LED module of the front fog lamps or front direction indicators may be non-replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp component approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

requirements.text: All lamps (front fog lamps and front direction indicators) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the fog lamps and direction indicators carry valid approval marks under the device regulations referenced in paragraph 6 (e.g. R148/R149).

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the logo-bearing direction indicator has an R148 approval covering the logo.

requirements.text: Lamps approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installed light sources and confirm they carry approval for the categories stated in the lamp approval.

requirements.text: The number of front fog lamps installed on the vehicle shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Count the front fog lamps installed on the vehicle; pass if exactly two are fitted.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall be of Class "F3" and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and communication form of each fog lamp; pass if Class F3 approved under R19 03+ or R149 00+.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the fog lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lowest point of the fog lamp apparent surface above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the highest point of the fog lamp apparent surface above ground; pass if ≤ 800 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the highest points of the fog lamp and dipped-beam headlamp apparent surfaces; pass if the fog lamp is not higher.

requirements.text: In length, the front fog lamps shall be at the front of the vehicle; this requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation position and assess from the driver's seat with lamps on; pass if lamps are at the front and cause no direct or indirect discomfort.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the front fog lamp shall be defined by angles α = 5° upwards and downwards and β = 45° outwards and 10° inwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Verify on vehicle/CAD that the apparent surface is unobstructed within α ±5° and β 45° out / 10° in; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.test_case: Inspect bezels and surrounding fascia parts with the lamp lit; pass if no stray reflections or glare to other road users.

requirements.text: The orientation of the front fog lamps shall be toward the front.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp reference axis direction; pass if directed toward the front.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be -1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.test_case: Measure cut-off inclination on unladen vehicle with driver; pass if ≤ -1.0 %.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens and the mounting height h of the lower edge of the apparent surface is ≤ 0.8 m, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent, with initial aiming between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure cut-off inclination under all Annex 5 static load conditions; pass if within -1.0 % to -3.0 % and initial aim within -1.5 % to -2.0 %.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the Annex 7 symbol with the inclination value to one decimal near the fog lamp or manufacturer's plate; pass if present, legible and indelible.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the value of the indicated initial downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Compare the marked inclination value with the initial aiming range of 6.3.6.1.2.1; pass if within range.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure cut-off inclination under all Annex 5 static loads with the levelling device active; pass if within 6.3.6.1.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut-off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.test_case: Simulate levelling device failure; pass if the cut-off does not become less inclined than at failure.

requirements.text: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS or cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Operate the switches in all headlamp combinations; pass if fog lamps can be switched ON and OFF independently.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front fog lamps.
requirements.test_case: Switch fog lamps ON; pass if a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates in the driver's view.

requirements.text: Where the luminous intensity of the front fog beam is indicated as variable in the communication form, any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
requirements.test_case: Observe intensity/alignment variation under changing ambient conditions; pass if automatic and causes no discomfort.

requirements.text: Arrangement "A" of direction-indicator lamps shall apply to all motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the categories and positions of all direction indicators on the vehicle; pass if they constitute arrangement A.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if direction-indicator lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check approval markings of the front direction indicators; pass if approved under R6 01+ or R148 00+.

requirements.text: The number of direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the arrangement.
requirements.test_case: Count direction indicators per category; pass if consistent with arrangement A.

requirements.text: The two front direction-indicator lamps shall be of category 1 or 1a or 1b if the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of this lamp and that of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is at least 40 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between apparent surface edges in the reference-axis direction; verify the approved indicator category is 1, 1a or 1b when distance ≥ 40 mm.

requirements.text: In width, the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outer apparent-surface edge to the extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the front direction-indicator lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between the inner apparent-surface edges; pass if ≥ 600 mm (≥ 400 mm if vehicle width < 1,300 mm).

requirements.text: The height above the ground of the front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8. on the unladen vehicle; pass if 350 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b shall meet the horizontal angles of geometric visibility given in the figure of paragraph 6.5.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the apparent surface on the vehicle over the horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.

requirements.text: The front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b shall have vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check unobstructed visibility at 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For the front direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane only.
requirements.test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane and 45° otherwise.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the front direction indicator lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector areas.

requirements.text: At the discretion of the manufacturer, for M1 vehicles, the front direction indicator lamps shall meet the alternative horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2, with the inward angle of 45° reducible to 20° under the H plane for lamps mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility against the alternative figure of paragraph 6.5.5.2.

requirements.text: Under the alternative arrangement, the front direction indicator lamps shall have vertical angles of 15° above and below the horizontal, the downward angle being reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical visibility 15° up/down (5° down if below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The orientation of the front direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
requirements.test_case: Compare installed orientation with the manufacturer's installation specification.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Operate the indicator control with all other lamps off/on and verify independent switching.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.
requirements.test_case: Activate the indicator on each side and verify all indicators on that side switch by one control and flash in phase.

requirements.text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
requirements.test_case: Activate the indicator and verify the mode does not change during the activation.

requirements.text: An operating tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b; it may be visual or auditory or both.
requirements.test_case: Verify presence of an operating tell-tale for the direction indicators on the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the direction-indicator tell-tale is visual, it shall be a flashing light which, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps, is either extinguished, or remains alight without flashing, or shows a marked change of frequency.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect one front indicator and verify the visual tell-tale extinguishes, stays lit steady or markedly changes frequency.

requirements.text: If the direction-indicator tell-tale is entirely auditory, it shall be clearly audible and shall show a marked change of frequency, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect one indicator and verify the audible signal markedly changes frequency.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator tell-tale shall be activated by the signal produced according to paragraph 6.2.2. of UN Regulation No. 6, or paragraph 5.6.3. of the 00 series or paragraph 4.6.1.4. of the 01 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148, or another suitable way.
requirements.test_case: Verify the front indicator lamp provides the failure signal per R6 6.2.2 / R148 and the tell-tale responds to it.

requirements.text: The light of the direction-indicator lamps shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.test_case: Measure flash frequency; pass if between 60 and 120 flashes per minute.

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
requirements.test_case: Measure time from control operation to first light ≤ 1 s and to first extinction ≤ 1.5 s.

requirements.text: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the others shall continue to flash, but the frequency in this condition may be different from that prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Open-circuit one front indicator and verify remaining indicators continue flashing.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5.
requirements.test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify all direction indicators including front ones operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously for the hazard warning signal shall operate in the same mode; i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify both front indicators operate in the same mode.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all the direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.
requirements.test_case: Operate the separate hazard control and verify all indicators flash in phase.

requirements.text: A flashing closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the hazard warning signal.
requirements.test_case: Activate hazard warning and verify a flashing closed-circuit tell-tale operates.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall meet the requirements of paragraph 6.5.9 (flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute, timing of first emission and extinction, continued flashing on failure).
requirements.test_case: Measure hazard flash frequency and timing per 6.5.9.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system.
requirements.test_case: With ignition/propulsion off, activate hazard warning and verify front indicators flash.

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, or its luminous intensity is reduced during that entire period to not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.
requirements.test_case: Measure edge distance; if ≤ 40 mm, activate indicator and verify DRL is OFF or ≤ 140 cd during the entire ON and OFF cycle.

requirements.text: Conspicuity markings shall not be fitted on vehicles of category M1; the front bumper assembly for the M1 vehicle shall not carry conspicuity markings.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the bumper assembly and confirm that no conspicuity marking material is applied.

requirements.text: Where the emergency stop signal is given by the direction-indicator lamps, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the direction-indicator lamps fitted (including the front direction indicators) as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal and verify that all direction-indicator lamps, including the front ones, operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Measure flash frequency and phase of all emergency stop signal lamps; pass if in phase and 3.0-5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall not be used to provide the answer-back signal.
requirements.test_case: Functional test of locking/unlocking: verify that the front fog lamps are not activated as part of the answer-back signal.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured lamp distances with the individual installation specifications of paragraphs 6.3 and 6.5; all within limits.

requirements.text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured visibility angles with the individual lamp specifications allowing ±3°; all fulfilled.

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamps shall be set to the plated figure as required and shown in Annex 7.
