requirements.test_case: Measure fog lamp cut-off inclination on unladen vehicle; equals plated figure per Annex 7.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps, front direction indicators and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate lamps and observe tell-tales; behaviour complies with paragraphs 5.11–5.14 and 6.3/6.5.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the front fog lamps and front direction indicators shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare inspected lamp colour, number, arrangement and category with paragraphs 5.15, 5.16, 6.3 and 6.5; all compliant.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position; if below 425 mm, verify that the flexible lower legform test of paragraph 5.1.1. is used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1 at all bumper test points; pass if |MCL elongation| <= 22 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1; pass if ACL and PCL elongations each <= 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para. 1; pass if |tibia bending moment| <= 340 Nm at all tibia segments.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths (relaxation zone) up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in those widths shall not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total <= 264 mm and that measured |tibia bending moment| <= 380 Nm within them.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 425-500 mm, verify the test report applies either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2. as chosen by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if at least 500 mm, verify the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 5.1.2. is applied.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Review the impactor certification record against Annex 6 para. 1 before testing.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para. 2; pass if summed impact force <= 7.5 kN at all times.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para. 2; pass if impactor bending moment <= 510 Nm.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 per cent ± 30 per cent and stabilized temperature of 20 ºC ± 4 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Record test facility and vehicle/bumper conditioning data; pass if relative humidity is 10-70 % and stabilized temperature is 16-24 °C at the time of testing.

requirements.text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 3.1.1. and 3.1.2. shall be used for the pedestrian impact test.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report/setup; pass if a complete vehicle or a cut-body including the front bumper assembly, prepared per 3.1.1/3.1.2, was used.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify vehicle ride height against normal ride attitude and mounting/parking brake condition before impact; pass if conforming.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the cut-body; pass if the complete front bumper assembly (fascia, absorber, beam, grille, lamps, sensors) and all other front-structure parts involved in pedestrian impact are present.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Check the cut-body fixture and measured attitude; pass if rigidly mounted at the normal ride attitude.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Verify activation status of any pedestrian protection devices before/during the test; pass if correctly activated/active.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components and test/assess lower leg impact in each fixed position; pass if limits are met in all positions.

requirements.text: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.test_case: Compare actual vs. target impact point; pass if within ±10 mm horizontally and vertically.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure impact velocity; pass if 10.9–11.3 m/s.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the lower legform to bumper tests shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area on the vehicle and verify all impact points lie within it.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review test plan; pass if at least one test in each third of the bumper test area at worst-case positions.

requirements.text: The lower legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.test_case: Check that selected points cover the different bumper structures (e.g. beam, crash box, fog lamp, sensor locations).

requirements.text: The selected lower legform test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral spacing between test points; pass if ≥ 84 mm.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±2° in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Measure velocity vector direction at first contact; pass if within ±2°.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper test, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor roll and pitch at first contact; pass if within ±2°.

requirements.text: The bottom of the lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper, with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor bottom height at first contact (high-speed video); pass if 75 ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
requirements.test_case: Verify from video that the impactor is detached from the launcher at impact.

requirements.text: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1 (e.g. the front direction indicator lamp).
requirements.test_case: Check that a separate R148 approval exists for the front direction indicator lamp function.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review approvals of each function in the unit; each function must comply with R148 or another applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The front direction indicator lamp shall be identified by the symbol 1, 1a, 1b, 11, 11a, 11b or 11c (paragraph 5.6.) as listed in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking on the indicator shows the correct category symbol from Table 1.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp drawings/sample for a marking space large enough for all required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub test; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a"; it must be ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for circle with E and country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for a 4–6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Verify sequential number is positioned adjacent to the E-circle.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for the function symbol(s) according to Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for "148R" followed by the two-digit series (e.g. 00/01).

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect handed lamps for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

requirements.text: For direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify arrow on handed indicator points outwards from vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D" shall be marked on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for letter D to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for downward vertical arrow from horizontal segment.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp sample for the complete approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for applicant trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for light source category marking.

requirements.text: Where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for LED substitute light source category marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with a variable luminous intensity control shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with a secondary operating mode shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for applicant trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1, followed by additional symbols or characters where several non-identical modules are used.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for identification code starting with MD and approval mark without circle.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for module identification code.

requirements.text: The approval mark in the module identification code does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.test_case: Compare module and lamp approval marks; both from same applicant.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Verify marking location is on a part not separable from the light-emitting lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With lamp installed in the bumper on the vehicle, verify the approval marking is visible (possibly after opening a movable part).

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect detachable lens and main body; both bear the approval marking.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body; only its own function approval markings present.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify all listed markings are physically on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component (light source module).
requirements.test_case: Verify module markings are on the module itself.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps complying with the requirements of several UN Regulations, the approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed in the bumper and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and confirm no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes of the individual marks.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the direction indicator lamp meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at the time of application.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the front direction indicator on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at lamp approval were verified.

requirements.text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration/durability assessment and confirm the lamp still operates and meets photometric and colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: Direction indicator lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the direction indicator lamp optics and outer lens and confirm no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic and confirm series-wired groups are treated as one light source in the failure analysis.

requirements.text: For direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 containing more than one light source, a signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option (a) any one light source has failed; (b) in the case of a lamp designed for only two light sources, the intensity in the axis of reference is less than 50 per cent of the minimum intensity required; or (c) as a consequence of a failure of one or more light sources, the intensity in one of the directions H=0°, V=0°; H=20° outwards to the outside of the vehicle, V=+5°; H=10° inwards to the inside of the vehicle, V=0°, as indicated in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 3, is less than the minimum intensity required.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failures and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced according to the declared option (a), (b) or (c).

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm its LED light sources are R128-approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in incorrect orientations and confirm only the correct position is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, applying the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed and, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no malfunction of other vehicle electronic systems.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt incorrect fitting and tool-less removal of the module; both must be impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design and confirm it cannot be opened or manipulated without destruction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit approved light sources and other modules of the same housing into the module seat; none must fit.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry against the requirements.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm photometric and colorimetric measurements followed paragraph 4.8 and Annex 3.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources for measurements.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous flux of the standard light source at test voltage; pass if within ±5 % of reference/objective flux.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometric test report shows measurements performed with the LED sources installed in the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Check test report for separate photometric measurements per applicable light source condition.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements of the front direction indicator, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect photometric setup for masking that prevents stray reflections.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check that photometric measurements were repeated for each position or extreme positions of the reference axis field.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the front direction indicator shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometric measurements are taken with steady (non-flashing) operation.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
requirements.test_case: Check measurement distance satisfies inverse-square law conditions.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
requirements.test_case: Verify receiver angular aperture is between 10' and 1°.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
requirements.test_case: Check intensity compliance within ±0.25° of each test direction.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction indicator lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction are documented.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify test supply voltage at lamp terminals is 13.5 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify lamp operated per applicant's specified conditions during tests.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify lamp operated per applicant's specification during tests.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Verify sources operated at reference flux or intensities proportionally corrected.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ minimum of paragraph 5 table.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure grid points of Annex 3 figure; pass if each ≥ required percentage or value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure within Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if ≥ specified minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Check measured distribution against Annex 3 local variation provisions.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Verify luminous intensity tests follow Annex 8 procedure.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect colour outside the grid field; pass if no sharp variation.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify colorimetric tests use paragraph 4.8 conditions.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Verify colorimetry measured with LEDs installed in the lamp.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the direction indicator lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 8 values; pass if all limits are met.

requirements.text: In the case of direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the minimum luminous intensities of Table 8 shall be fulfilled in the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis; pass if at least the Table 8 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1, the luminous intensity shall be at least 1.75∙10² cd minimum, not exceed 1.20∙10³ cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10⁻¹ cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; pass if within category 1 limits.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1b, the luminous intensity shall be at least 4.00∙10² cd minimum, not exceed 1.20∙10³ cd when used as a single lamp or 6.00∙10² cd for a lamp marked "D", meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 with a minimum luminous intensity of 7∙10⁻¹ cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; pass if within category 1b limits.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the direction indicator lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across Table A2-1 angles; pass if not below the Table 8 minimum.

requirements.text: In general, the intensities of the direction indicator lamp shall be measured with the light source(s) continuously alight.
requirements.test_case: Verify test report states measurement with light sources continuously alight, or justified flashing mode.

requirements.text: When the direction indicator lamp (e.g. using LEDs) is measured in flashing mode, this shall be achieved by switching with a frequency of f = 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with the pulse width greater than 0.3 s, measured at 95 per cent peak light intensity.
requirements.test_case: Check flashing test setup frequency and pulse width; pass if 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz and >0.3 s.

requirements.text: In all other cases of flashing-mode measurement of the direction indicator lamp, the voltage as required in paragraph 4.8. shall be switched with a rise time and fall time shorter than 0.01 s, with no overshoot.
requirements.test_case: Oscilloscope check of supply switching; pass if rise/fall <0.01 s and no overshoot.

requirements.text: In the case of measurements of the direction indicator lamp taken in flashing mode, the reported luminous intensity shall be represented by the maximum intensity.
requirements.test_case: Review report; pass if maximum intensity is reported for flashing measurements.

requirements.text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Observe in flashing mode; pass if each activated segment stays lit until end of ON cycle.

requirements.text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation, the sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Visual/video check in flashing mode; pass if progression is uniform inboard to outboard.

requirements.text: If the flash of the direction indicator lamp is produced by sequential activation, it shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis).
requirements.test_case: Video analysis; pass if single uninterrupted signal with at most one vertical direction change.

requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface shall not exceed 50 mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure gaps perpendicular to reference axis; pass if ≤50 mm.

requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the variation shall finish no more than 200 ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Time-resolved measurement; pass if sequence completes ≤200 ms after ON start.

requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the orthogonal projection of the light emitting surfaces in the direction of the axis of reference shall be circumscribed by a rectangle on a plane normal to the axis of reference with its longer sides parallel to the H-plane, and the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides shall not be less than 1.7.
requirements.test_case: Measure circumscribing rectangle of projected surface; pass if ratio ≥1.7.

requirements.text: For a sequential direction indicator, the interruptions of the signal shall not create any overlap in the vertical axis between the different parts, from inboard towards the outboard of the vehicle, and shall not be used for any other lighting or light signalling functions.
requirements.test_case: Inspect drawing/lamp; pass if no vertical overlap and gaps not used by other functions.

requirements.text: Compliance of the sequential direction indicator with the sequential activation conditions shall be verified in flashing mode.
requirements.test_case: Confirm verification performed with lamp operated in flashing mode.

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Apply paragraph 4.6 failure tests; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the direction indicator lamp shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement; pass if chromaticity within amber boundaries.

requirements.text: The front direction indicator (categories 1, 1a, 1b) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard, as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed apparent surface visibility horizontally; pass if visible from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The front direction indicator (categories 1, 1a, 1b) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the horizontal, as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure vertical visibility; pass if the lamp is visible from 15° above to 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: For front direction indicators (categories 1, 1a, 1b) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard and 80° outboard shall be used only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and check horizontal visibility below the H-plane is at least 20° inboard / 80° outboard.

requirements.text: For front direction indicators (categories 1, 1a, 1b) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Verify mounting height < 750 mm and check vertical visibility of at least 15° above and 5° below.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities of the front direction indicator lamps as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the front direction indicator; compare each measured direction to the rounded-down percentage of the required minimum and pass if all are met.

requirements.text: In the case where the front direction indicator lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check manufacturer's declared mounting height; if ≤750 mm, verify photometric intensities only down to 5° below horizontal and pass if minima are met within that field.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity of the front direction indicator lamps in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity between grid points of the light distribution; pass if every intermediate direction meets at least the lowest surrounding grid percentage value.

requirements.text: The front direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a or 1b shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 8).
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at Figure A3-I grid points; pass if each value is at least the stated percentage of the Table 8 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: For the LED front direction indicator lamps (light source technology other than incandescent), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min and after 30 min (or at photometric stability) and verify all test points are within the min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the photometric tests of the LED front direction indicator lamps, operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.test_case: Check the test record shows the indicator was operated at 1.5 Hz with 50 per cent duty factor during the photometric measurements.

requirements.text: For any LED front position lamps, daytime running lamps or side marker lamps integrated in the bumper (light source technology other than incandescent), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability and verify min/max compliance at all test points.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the front direction indicator lamps (Cat 1, 2, 11, 12) shall in addition be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure or calculate (via ratio at HV) the intensity distribution at 0.2 s after switch ON and verify compliance with the intensity requirements.

requirements.text: In case the front direction indicator lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamp uses LED technology only and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements are compliant.

requirements.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the front direction indicator lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity continuously from 0.2 s after switch ON until photometric stability and verify minimum values are met throughout.

requirements.text: A separate approval is required for the front fog lamp as a lamp listed in paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the front fog lamp holds its own type approval under UN R149.

requirements.text: When the front fog lamp is part of the same assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval is granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of this Regulation or of another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that every lamp in the assembly has a valid approval under R149 or another applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying any one of those Regulations shall not be part of an assembly of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps including the front fog lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the assembly's lamp list and confirm no non-compliant lamp is included.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to the front fog lamp type shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front fog lamp for the approval number marked as per paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be identified by the symbol "F3" for a front fog lamp of Class F3, or "YF3" if the device is part of a matched pair, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the fog lamp for the symbol F3 (or YF3 if matched pair).

requirements.text: The change index for the front fog lamp of Class F3 shall be 0 for the 00 series of amendments and 1 for the 01 series of amendments, as given in Table 2.
requirements.test_case: Check that the marked change index matches the series of amendments of the approval per Table 2.

requirements.text: Every front fog lamp belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4. or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fog lamp drawing/sample for a marking space sufficient for the UI or approval marking and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings on the front fog lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform a rub/durability check; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: The value for "a" in part 1 of Annex 13 shall be at least 5 mm on plastic material and at least 8 mm on glass.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a" on the lamp; ≥5 mm on plastic, ≥8 mm on glass.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp marking and confirm a circle with letter E and the approving country number is present.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the 4-6 digit sequential approval number matches the approval certificate.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for '149R' followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the front fog lamp shall include the symbol(s) according to Table 1 and, if applicable, the additional symbol(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the front fog lamp class symbol per Table 1 (e.g. F3) is present.

requirements.text: Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: For asymmetric F3 lamps, inspect the marking for an arrow pointing to the vehicle outside on each side-specific lamp.

requirements.text: In the case of road illumination devices incorporating an outer lens of plastic material, the group of letters "PL" shall be affixed near the symbols identifying the function(s).
requirements.test_case: Verify the PC outer lens fog lamp marking shows 'PL' adjacent to the function symbol.

requirements.text: The approval number, the symbols and the additional symbols shall be placed close to the circle and either above or below the letter "E", or to the right or left of that letter.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking layout and confirm number and symbols are adjacent to the circle above/below/left/right of the E.

requirements.text: The digits of the approval number shall be on the same side of the letter "E" and face the same direction.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm all approval number digits are on one side of the E and oriented identically.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, each symbol shall be marked individually in accordance with Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm each function symbol is marked separately per Table 1.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If UI used, compare the marked UI against the Figure I format and check database reference.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall bear the approval marking or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fog lamp for an approval marking or UI.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fog lamp housing or lens for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed and, where approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: If replaceable light sources are used, inspect the marking for the prescribed light source category(ies).

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the specific identification code(s) of the light source module(s).
requirements.test_case: If replaceable modules are used, check the lamp marking shows the module identification code(s).

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable UN approved light source(s) or with replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp marking for rated voltage or voltage range.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with non-replaceable light source modules, the lamp shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If modules are non-replaceable, inspect the lamp for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a specific identification code comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the markings described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2. and, where several non-identical modules are used, additional symbols or characters; this code shall be shown in the drawings and the module mark shall be from the same applicant as the lamp mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for an 'MD' code with E-number and sequential number and compare to drawings.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the front fog lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If external control gear exists, inspect it for identification code and rated input voltage marking.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps meeting the requirements of Annex 7 only when supplied with a voltage of 12V, a marking consisting of the Number 24 crossed out by an oblique cross (X) shall be placed near the holders of the light source(s) as shown in Annex 12.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp is 12V-only for Annex 7, verify the crossed-out '24' marking near the light source holders.

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the front fog lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm the marking is on an inner or outer part of the lamp.

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the front fog lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With the bumper fitted on the vehicle, check the fog lamp approval marking is visible (possibly after opening a movable part).

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the front fog lamp is designed to be separated from the main body, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the lens is detachable, verify the marking appears on both lens and housing.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: If the lens is shared, inspect each device body and confirm it bears only its own function's marking.

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, all the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall satisfy the pertinent Regulation and the requirements of paragraph 3.3.2. shall apply.
requirements.test_case: If a single mark is used, verify each incorporated lamp's approval and paragraph 3.3.2 marking content.

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that every light-transmitting part removed also removes the approval mark.

requirements.text: In the case of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bearing a single Unique Identifier or approval mark, the symbols for each lamp, appropriate to each UN Regulation under which approval has been granted, shall be marked either on the appropriate light-emitting surface or in a group in such a way that each lamp may be clearly identified.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm each function's symbol is on its light-emitting surface or clearly identifiable in a group.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by test report that the fog lamp meets paragraphs 4 and 5 requirements.

requirements.text: The requirements of sections 5 and 6 of UN Regulation No. 48 (and referenced Annexes) pertinent to the front fog lamp and to the M1 category of vehicle on which it is intended to be installed shall be applied, where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check installation-related R48 provisions verifiable at lamp level (e.g. geometric visibility) are documented as met.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration/durability evaluation and confirm photometry remains within limits afterwards.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them, unless the reflector and diffusing lens cannot be separated and the use of such units is confined to vehicles on which the lamp setting can be adjusted by other means.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fog lamp for an aiming adjustment device or confirm vehicle-side adjustment for indivisible units.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps whose adjusting device does not provide horizontal adjustment, the front fog lamps shall be so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
requirements.test_case: Adjust vertical aim through its range and verify horizontal aim remains within tolerance.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp's light source(s) and confirm each is an approved replaceable light source, a light source module or a non-replaceable light source.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the front fog lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to insert the light source in incorrect orientations; pass if only the correct position is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder of the front fog lamp shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Check holder dimensions against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet; pass if within the specified characteristics.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source holder of the front fog lamp shall conform to the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet for the LED substitute light source category; pass if conforming.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing at vehicle level; pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems occurs.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the module in other positions; pass if only the designated correct position is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt removal of the module by hand; pass if removal requires tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module construction; pass if it cannot be opened or modified without visible damage.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit UN approved light sources into the module seat and vice versa; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different characteristics within the housing; pass if mechanically impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the front fog lamp shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another bearing the same identification code and repeat photometry; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: If applicable, the light source modules of the front fog lamp shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Test light source modules to Annex 9; pass if all Annex 9 requirements are met.

requirements.text: The luminous flux of the light source(s) of the front fog lamp shall be determined according to the provisions in paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify the luminous flux measurement was carried out under the conditions of paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: All photometric and colorimetric measurements of the front fog lamp shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.6.1, with the methods of measurement given in Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm measurements followed paragraph 4.6.1 conditions and Annex 4 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements of the front fog lamp shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that standard light sources per R.E.5 were used for measurements.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure standard light source flux at test voltage; pass if within ±5 % of reference/objective value.

requirements.text: In the case of a front fog lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Confirm measurements were made with the lamp's own light sources installed.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements of the front fog lamp, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect photometric set-up for appropriate masking against stray reflections.

requirements.text: In the case where the front fog lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometry at each position or extreme positions of the reference axis field; pass if all meet requirements.

requirements.text: In the case where the front fog lamp shall also be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all photometric and colorimetric measurements shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometric and colorimetric measurements with the prescribed LED substitute light sources; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the front fog lamp for testing shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test supply voltage at the lamp was 13.2 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

requirements.text: In case of a front fog lamp and/or a light source module controlled by an electronic light source control gear, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamp was operated during testing per the applicant's specification with the control gear.

requirements.text: In case of a front fog lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test voltage at the lamp input terminals matches the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: In case of a front fog lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear with replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check light sources were run at reference flux or intensities were proportionally corrected.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities and colorimetric characteristics of the front fog lamp shall be carried out according to Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Perform luminous intensity and colorimetric tests per Annex 10; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the front fog lamp is made of plastic material, tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 plastic material tests on the PC outer lens; pass if all Annex 8 criteria are met.

requirements.text: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3, unless low-UV type light sources as specified in the relevant UN Regulation or in Annex 9 are used or provisions are taken to shield the relevant lamp components from UV radiation.
requirements.test_case: Perform the UV resistance test of Annex 8 paragraph 3.3 on internal plastic components, or verify low-UV light sources/UV shielding.

requirements.text: The sharpness and linearity of the cut-off of the front fog lamp, if applicable, shall be tested according to the requirements in Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Test cut-off sharpness and linearity per Annex 6; pass if Annex 6 criteria are met.

requirements.text: Complementary tests shall be done on the front fog lamp according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
requirements.test_case: Perform Annex 7 stability-of-photometric-performance tests; pass if changes stay within Annex 7 limits.

requirements.text: The component(s) of the front fog lamp to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and trial-fit the replaceable light source; verify it fits easily and only in the correct position.

requirements.text: For photometric adjustment and measuring conditions of the front fog lamp, Annex 4 shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify photometric tests are conducted with adjustment and measuring conditions per Annex 4.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric testing with a standard (étalon) light source and verify compliance with paragraph 5 requirements.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be white, or selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light and verify they lie within the white (or selective yellow, if requested) boundaries.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.4. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
requirements.test_case: Aim the fog lamp on the goniometer per Annex 5 para 3.4 and confirm the aim is within the para 4 tolerances.

requirements.text: If vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the symmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.
requirements.test_case: If repeated visual aiming fails, apply the Annex 6 para 2 instrumental method and verify cut-off quality meets the minimum.

requirements.text: When so adjusted, the front fog lamp shall meet the requirements as shown in Table 17 and Figure A4-X.
requirements.test_case: Measure the aimed fog lamp at all Table 17 points, lines and zones and confirm every value is within limits.

requirements.text: At points P1 and P2 (60°U, 45°L and 45°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 8.5∙10^1 cd at all points.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at P1 and P2; pass if each value ≤ 85 cd.

requirements.text: On Line 1 (8°U, 26°L to 26°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 1.30∙10^2 cd along the whole line.
requirements.test_case: Scan Line 1; pass if maximum ≤ 130 cd.

requirements.text: On Line 6 (2.5°D, from 5° inwards to 10° outward), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be at least 2.70∙10^3 cd along the whole line; in case of lamps constituting a matched pair, the half of the sum of the measured values from both lamps does not apply to this element.
requirements.test_case: Scan Line 6 on each individual lamp; pass if minimum ≥ 2700 cd.

requirements.text: On Line 7 (6°D, from 5° inwards to 10° outward), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 0.5 x the actual measured maximum value on Line 6 along the whole line; in case of lamps constituting a matched pair, the half of the sum of the measured values from both lamps does not apply to this element.
requirements.test_case: Scan Line 7 and compare with Line 6 maximum; pass if every value ≤ 0.5 × Line 6 maximum.

requirements.text: On Lines 8L and 8R (1.5°D to 3.5°D, 22°L and 22°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be at least 1.10∙10^3 cd at one or more points.
requirements.test_case: Scan Lines 8L and 8R; pass if at least one point on each line ≥ 1100 cd.

requirements.text: In Zone D (1.5°D to 3.5°D, 10°L to 10°R), the luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall not exceed 1.20∙10^4 cd in the whole zone.
requirements.test_case: Map Zone D; pass if maximum ≤ 12000 cd.

requirements.text: Variations in homogeneity of the front fog lamp beam detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the beam pattern above line 5 between 10°L and 10°R; pass if no detrimental homogeneity variations.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the front fog lamp shall be measured either with white light or coloured light as prescribed by the applicant for use of the fog lamp in normal service.
requirements.test_case: Confirm photometric measurement was made with the light colour declared for normal service.

requirements.text: Discontinuities in intensities of the front fog lamp beam detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the beam between lines 6, 7, 8 and 9; pass if no detrimental intensity discontinuities.

requirements.text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern of the front fog lamp should be substantially uniform.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the isocandela map between lines 1 and 5 for substantial uniformity.

requirements.text: In the light-distribution of the front fog lamp as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 are allowed only with not more than 1.75∙10^2 cd and if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.test_case: Identify any spots/stripes in the area; pass if each ≤ 175 cd and within a 2° cone or 1° width.

requirements.text: If multiple spots or stripes are present in the front fog lamp light-distribution, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
requirements.test_case: Measure angular separation between spots/stripes; pass if ≥ 10°.

requirements.text: To adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, automatic variation of the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp is permitted only if an active electronic light source control gear is incorporated into the front fog lamp function system.
requirements.test_case: Verify by design documentation and inspection that an active electronic light source control gear is part of the fog lamp system.

requirements.text: To adapt to dense fog or similar conditions of reduced visibility, automatic variation of the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp is permitted only if all intensities are varied proportionately.
requirements.test_case: Measure the beam at several intensity states; pass if all point intensities scale proportionately.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp system with automatically varied luminous intensities, when checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.
requirements.test_case: Check per para 4.6.2.1; pass if intensities in all states stay within 60–100 % of Table 17 values.

requirements.text: For photometric measurement, the front fog lamp or part(s) thereof shall be mounted on a goniometer with a fixed horizontal axis and moveable axis perpendicular to the fixed horizontal axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test setup: the fog lamp is mounted on a goniometer with a fixed horizontal axis and a perpendicular moveable axis.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity values of the front fog lamp shall be determined by means of a photoreceptor contained within a square of 65 mm side and set up to a distance of at least 25 m forward of the centre of reference of each lamp perpendicular to the measurement axis from the origin of the goniometer.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the photoreceptor fits within a 65 mm square and is placed at least 25 m from the centre of reference.

requirements.text: Before starting the measurements, the front fog lamp or part(s) thereof shall be aimed as described in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify the fog lamp was aimed per Annex 5 before photometric measurement, as recorded in the test report.
