requirements.text: The aiming of the front fog lamp shall be carried out using a flat vertical screen set up at a distance of 10 m or 25 m (as indicated in item 9 of Annex 1) forward of the device and at right angles to the H-V axis as shown in Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms aiming on a flat vertical screen at 10 m or 25 m, perpendicular to the H-V axis.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the front fog lamp in its neutral state shall incorporate a "cut-off".
requirements.test_case: Project the fog lamp beam on the aiming screen and verify a visible cut-off line is present.

requirements.text: The symmetric "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp shall provide a straight "horizontal part" towards the left and the right (see Figure A5-II).
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the projected beam on the screen and confirm a straight horizontal cut-off extending to both left and right.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II).
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test report that the fog lamp was aimed visually using the symmetric cut-off line.

requirements.text: For vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp, the "cut-off" is moved upward from below line B and adjusted to its nominal position 1 degree below the H-H line.
requirements.test_case: Aim the fog lamp moving the cut-off upward from below line B and verify it is set at 1° below H-H.

requirements.text: For horizontal adjustment of the front fog lamp, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line (according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.).
requirements.test_case: Verify the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical about the V-V line after horizontal aiming.

requirements.text: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal alignment follows the applicant's specification, or that the cut-off appears symmetrical to V-V.

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamp aimed as described in paragraph 3. does not meet the device specific requirements set out in paragraphs 5. or 6.2. of this Regulation, its alignment may be changed only provided that the axis of the beam is not displaced horizontally by more than 2° to the left or to the right.
requirements.test_case: If re-aiming was used, verify the recorded horizontal beam axis shift does not exceed 2° left or right.

requirements.text: If vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the tolerances described in paragraph 4.1., the instrumental method of Annex 6 shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam.
requirements.test_case: Where visual vertical aiming is not repeatable within tolerance, verify the Annex 6 instrumental method was used and the cut-off quality requirements are met.

requirements.text: The instrumental aiming method shall be applied to test compliance of the front fog lamp with the required minimum quality of the "cut-off" and to perform the vertical and horizontal adjustment of the beam only if the vertical adjustment of the front fog lamp cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position and tolerances described in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Attempt visual vertical aim per Annex 5 repeatedly; if not repeatable within tolerances, verify instrumental method is used for cut-off quality and aiming.

requirements.text: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the quality of the "cut-off" line of the front fog lamp shall be tested according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.2.
requirements.test_case: Verify cut-off quality test records follow Annex 6 paragraph 2.2.

requirements.text: In the case where paragraph 1.2. applies, the instrumental vertical and horizontal adjustment of the front fog lamp beam shall be performed according to the requirements set out in paragraph 2.3.
requirements.test_case: Verify beam adjustment records follow Annex 6 paragraph 2.3.

requirements.text: Before carrying out the measurement of the quality of "cut-off" and the instrumental aiming procedure of the front fog lamp, a visual pre-aim in accordance with device specific paragraph(s) of Annex 5 is required.
requirements.test_case: Check test procedure includes visual pre-aim per Annex 5 before instrumental measurement.

requirements.text: To determine the minimum sharpness of the front fog lamp "cut-off", measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° at either a measurement distance of 10 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 10 mm, or 25 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
requirements.test_case: Verify scan step 0.05° and distance/detector combination of 10 m/10 mm or 25 m/30 mm in test report.

requirements.text: The "cut-off" quality of the front fog lamp shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.
requirements.test_case: Check that at least one measurement set meets all of paragraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.3.

requirements.text: To determine the linearity of the front fog lamp "cut-off", measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° exclusively at a measurement distance of 25 m and with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
requirements.test_case: Verify linearity scans made at 25 m with ~30 mm detector in 0.05° steps.

requirements.text: Not more than one "cut-off" of the front fog lamp shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect beam on aiming screen; pass if only one cut-off is visible.

requirements.text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the sharpness factor G, determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" at 2.5° left and right from the V-V line, shall not be less than 0.08 (minimum sharpness).
requirements.test_case: Compute G = log Eβ − log E(β+0.1°) from vertical scans at 2.5°L and 2.5°R; pass if G ≥ 0.08.

requirements.text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.test_case: Scan cut-off between 3°L and 3°R and verify it is horizontal.

requirements.text: For a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the maximum vertical distance between the inflection points of the "cut-off" gradient determined by the equation d2(log E)/dβ2 = 0 shall not exceed 0.5°.
requirements.test_case: Determine inflection points at the specified vertical lines; pass if maximum vertical spread ≤ 0.5°.

requirements.text: For vertical adjustment of a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, a vertical scan moving upward from below line B shall be carried out on the V-V line and the inflection point (where d2(log E)/dβ2 = 0) shall be positioned on the line B situated 1° below H-H line.
requirements.test_case: Perform vertical scan on V-V line and verify inflection point is set at 1° below H-H.

requirements.text: For horizontal adjustment of a front fog lamp designed to provide a symmetric "cut-off" line, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.test_case: Inspect projected beam on screen; pass if pattern is approximately symmetrical to V-V line.

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the "cut-off" line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal alignment matches applicant specification, or else cut-off appears symmetrical to V-V line.

requirements.text: Once the photometric values of the front fog lamp have been measured according to this Regulation at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV, a complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.
requirements.test_case: Record Imax in zone D and HV values, then run the Annex 7 stability test on a complete fog lamp sample.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps, the complete sample tested shall be the complete lamp itself including ballast(s) and those surrounding body parts, light sources or light source module(s) which could influence its thermal dissipation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test sample includes the lamp, LED modules, any control gear and the surrounding bumper/bezel parts affecting heat dissipation.

requirements.text: The stability tests on the front fog lamp shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, the test sample being mounted on a base representing the correct installation on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify test records show ambient 23 °C ± 5 °C, still air and a fixture representing vehicle installation.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light sources in the front fog lamp, the tests shall be carried out using mass production LED light sources and LED modules which have been aged for at least 48 hours and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests.
requirements.test_case: Check ageing log shows at least 48 h ageing and cool-down to ambient before testing.

requirements.text: The LED modules supplied by the applicant shall be used for the stability tests of the front fog lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify the LED modules tested are those supplied by the applicant.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp test sample shall be operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
requirements.test_case: Verify the sample remained on the fixture without readjustment throughout the test.

requirements.text: The clean front fog lamp shall be operated for 12 hours as described in paragraph 2.1.1. and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Operate the clean lamp for 12 h and then perform visual and photometric checks.

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamp is designed to provide only one lighting function (front fog lamp), the corresponding light emitting element(s) shall be lit for the time specified in paragraph 2.1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the fog lamp light emitting elements were lit continuously for 12 h.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps with non-replaceable light sources operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, all measurements shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V or at other voltages according to the vehicle voltage system as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied terminal voltage was 13.2 V (or declared value) during the test.

requirements.text: LED light source(s) and light source module(s) of the front fog lamp shall be measured at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified; those operated by an electronic light source control gear shall be measured as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify LED modules were operated at 13.2 V (12 V system) or as specified by the applicant for control gear.

requirements.text: For light sources operated independently from vehicle supply voltage and fully controlled by the system, or supplied by a supply and operating device, the test voltages shall be applied to the input terminals of that device.
requirements.test_case: Check test voltage was applied at the input terminals of the supply and operating device.

requirements.text: After the stability test, on visual inspection no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the lens or the external lens, if any, of the front fog lamp shall be noticeable.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the lens; pass if no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour change.

requirements.text: Once the front fog lamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, the lens and the external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Verify lens cleaning with a damp cotton cloth after cool-down.

requirements.text: After the stability test, the photometric values of the front fog lamp shall be verified on point HV and Imax in zone D, with a 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test permissible including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV and Imax in zone D after the test; pass if within 10 % of pre-test values.

requirements.text: After being tested as specified in paragraph 2.1., the front fog lamp shall be operated for one hour as described in paragraph 2.1.1. after being prepared as prescribed in paragraph 2.2.1., and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Operate the soiled lamp for 1 h and repeat visual and photometric checks.

requirements.text: For the front fog lamp, the test mixture shall be uniformly applied to the entire light-emitting surface and then left to dry, repeated until the illumination value has dropped to 15-20 per cent of the value measured at Imax in zone D.
requirements.test_case: Apply the Appendix 2 mixture repeatedly and confirm Imax in zone D is reduced to 15-20 % before operation.

requirements.text: The vertical drift of the cut-off line of the front fog lamp under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value; the device tested in accordance with paragraph 2. shall be subjected to the test of paragraph 3.1. without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
requirements.test_case: Perform the cut-off drift test on the same fixture-mounted sample after paragraph 2 tests.

requirements.text: For the cut-off drift test of the front fog lamp, the voltage shall be adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2. and the test shall be carried out in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C, with the device operated without being dismounted from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
requirements.test_case: Verify voltage, ambient 23 °C ± 5 °C and undisturbed fixture in the test record.

requirements.text: The cut-off drift test of the front fog lamp shall use mass production LED light source(s) and/or LED module(s) as submitted with the device, which have been aged for at least 48 hours.
requirements.test_case: Check the LED modules used are production parts aged at least 48 h.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps, the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure cut-off vertical position at 3 min and 60 min between 3.0°L and 3.0°R.

requirements.text: For front fog lamps, the result shall be considered acceptable when the absolute value Δr1 = |r3 - r60| recorded on the device is not more than 2.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).
requirements.test_case: Compute |r3 - r60|; pass if ≤ 2.0 mrad.

requirements.text: After the three stabilisation cycles, the front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on the further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure Δr on the further sample after the three cycles; pass if Δr meets paragraph 3.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: If the result of the test for change in vertical position of the cut-off line does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample of the front fog lamp mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle of one hour operation (voltage adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2.) and one hour with the lamp switched OFF, in order to stabilise the position of the mechanical parts of the device.
requirements.test_case: Mount a further sample on a representative fixture, run three cycles of 1 h ON / 1 h OFF at the specified voltage, then repeat the paragraph 3.1 test; check the procedure is followed.

requirements.text: For the further-sample procedure to be applicable to a front fog lamp, the upward movement of the cut-off line shall not exceed 3.0 mrad as given in Table A7-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upward movement of the first sample; further-sample retest allowed only if it is ≤ 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: The samples of plastic lenses or material of the front fog lamp supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2. shall satisfy the requirements indicated in paragraphs 3.1. to 3.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform tests 3.1 to 3.6 on the lens/material samples; pass if all results meet the stated limits.

requirements.text: The two samples of complete front fog lamps supplied pursuant to paragraph 3.1.2.4. of this Regulation and incorporating lenses of plastic material shall, with regard to the lens material, satisfy the requirements indicated in paragraph 3.7.
requirements.test_case: Perform the paragraph 3.7 tests on the two complete lamps; pass if the photometric and coating adherence results comply.

requirements.text: The samples (lenses of plastic material or samples of material) shall be subjected, with the optical assembly to which they are intended to be fitted (where applicable), to approval tests in the chronological order indicated in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report sequence against Table A8-1; pass if the tests were done in the prescribed order.

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses) of the front fog lamp shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change: 3 h at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 85-95 per cent RH; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 15 h at -30 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH; 3 h at 80 °C ± 2 °C; 1 h at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH.
requirements.test_case: Run five climatic cycles per the programme on three new lenses and record the chamber profile; pass if the profile complies.

requirements.text: Photometric measurements shall be carried out on the samples before and after the temperature change test.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the test report contains photometric measurements taken before and after cycling.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, the photometric measurements shall be made after photometric stability using a standard (étalon) light source, or with the light source(s) and/or light source module(s) present in the lamp, at the intersection of the V-V line with line 6 and the intersection of the V-V line with line 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at V-V/line 6 and V-V/line 4 after photometric stability; pass if measurements were taken at these points.

requirements.text: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the temperature change test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.test_case: Compare the before and after photometric values per sample; pass if the variation is ≤ 10 %.

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be exposed to radiation from a source with a spectral energy distribution similar to a black body at 5,500 K to 6,000 K, filtered to reduce wavelengths below 295 nm and above 2,500 nm, at an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2 until they receive a luminous energy of 4,500 MJ/m2 ± 200 MJ/m2.
requirements.test_case: Review the weathering test record; pass if irradiance, spectrum, filtering and total radiant exposure comply.

requirements.text: After the atmospheric agents test and the measurement of paragraph 3.2.3.1., the outer face of the three samples shall be treated as described in paragraph 3.2.2.2. with the test mixture of 61.5 per cent n-heptane, 12.5 per cent toluene, 7.5 per cent ethyl tetrachloride, 12.5 per cent trichloroethylene and 6 per cent xylene (volume per cent).
requirements.test_case: Apply the defined mixture with a saturated cotton pad at 50 N/cm2 for 10 min; pass if the procedure was followed.

requirements.text: After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the outer face of the samples shall be free from cracks, scratches, chipping and deformation.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the samples after weathering; pass if there are no cracks, scratches, chipping or deformation.

requirements.text: After the test of resistance to atmospheric agents, the mean variation in transmission measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 to this Annex shall not exceed 0.020 (Δtm < 0.020).
requirements.test_case: Measure transmission per Appendix 2 before and after weathering; pass if the mean Δt < 0.020.

requirements.text: After the test of resistance to chemical agents, the samples shall not bear any traces of chemical staining likely to cause a variation of flux diffusion, whose mean variation measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 to this Annex shall not exceed 0.020 (Δdm < 0.020).
requirements.test_case: Inspect for staining and measure diffusion per Appendix 2; pass if no staining is present and the mean Δd < 0.020.

requirements.text: If necessary, flat samples of each light transmitting plastic component of the front fog lamp, with the same colour and surface treatment as the lamp parts and at the same angles and distances as in the lamp, shall be exposed to the light of the light source(s); after 1,500 hours of continuous operation, the colorimetric requirements of the transmitted light must be met with a new light source.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples for 1,500 h, then measure chromaticity with a new light source; pass if within the colour limits.

requirements.text: After 1,500 hours of continuous exposure to the light source radiation, the surfaces of the samples shall be free of cracks, scratches, scalings or deformation.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the samples after 1,500 h exposure; pass if there are no cracks, scratches, scaling or deformation.

requirements.text: After the detergent and hydrocarbon tests have been performed successively, the mean value of the variation in transmission measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 shall not exceed 0.010 (Δtm < 0.010).
requirements.test_case: Measure transmission per Appendix 2 before and after both tests; pass if the mean Δt < 0.010.

requirements.text: The outer face of three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Appendix 3 abrasion test on three new lenses; pass if the method was followed.

requirements.text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the mean variations measured on the three samples according to Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1. shall be Δtm < 0.100 in transmission and Δdm < 0.050 in diffusion.
requirements.test_case: Measure transmission and diffusion per Appendix 2; pass if the mean Δt < 0.100 and the mean Δd < 0.050.

requirements.text: After the coating adherence test, there shall be no appreciable impairment of the gridded area; impairments at the intersections between squares or at the edges of the cuts are permitted provided that the impaired area does not exceed 15 per cent of the gridded surface.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the gridded area after tape removal; pass if the impaired area is ≤ 15 % and confined to intersections and cut edges.

requirements.text: The lens of complete front fog lamp sample No. 1 shall be subjected to the mechanical deterioration test described in paragraph 3.5.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Appendix 3 abrasion test on the lens of complete lamp No. 1; pass if the test was performed.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps, after the mechanical deterioration test of the lens, the results of photometric measurements prescribed for lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry on lines 2 and 5 of the abraded lamp; pass if the values are ≤ 130 % of the prescribed maxima.

requirements.text: The lens of complete front fog lamp sample No. 2 shall be subjected to the coating adherence test described in paragraph 3.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the cross-cut tape test on the lens of complete lamp No. 2; pass if the impairment is ≤ 15 % of the gridded area.

requirements.text: The tests on plastic materials (lenses or samples of material supplied pursuant to paragraph 1.2.) of the front fog lamp shall be carried out in the chronological order given in Table A8-1 (limited photometry, temperature change, transmission and diffusion measurements, atmospheric agents, chemical agents, detergents, hydrocarbons, deterioration, adherence).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the plastic lens/material samples were tested in the sequence of Table A8-1.

requirements.text: Each LED module sample submitted shall conform to the relevant requirements of this Regulation when tested with the supplied electronic light source control-gear(s), if any.
requirements.test_case: Test each LED module sample with its supplied control gear and verify compliance with all relevant R149 requirements.

requirements.text: The LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Review design and operate the LED module under normal-use conditions; verify it works correctly throughout.

requirements.text: The LED module(s) shall exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
requirements.test_case: Inspect LED module samples for design or manufacturing defects; pass if none found.

requirements.text: The LED(s) on the LED module shall be equipped with suitable fixation elements.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the LED module and verify each LED has suitable fixation elements.

requirements.text: The fixation elements of the LED module shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and mechanically check the fixation elements; pass if firmly secured to LEDs and module without looseness.

requirements.text: All LED module samples shall be tested as specified in paragraph 4 of Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows all LED module samples tested per Annex 9 paragraph 4 (colour rendering, UV).

requirements.text: All LED module samples shall be tested under the conditions as specified in paragraphs 4.6.2.1.1. and 4.6.2.2.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that test voltages/operating conditions applied to the LED modules match paragraphs 4.6.2.1.1. and 4.6.2.2.1.

requirements.text: For the measurement of electrical and photometric characteristics, the LED module device shall be operated in a dry and still atmosphere at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Verify the measurement environment was dry, still air at 23 °C ± 5 °C during electrical and photometric measurements.

requirements.text: Upon the request of the applicant the LED module shall be operated for 15 h and cooled down to ambient temperature before starting the tests as specified in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If ageing requested, verify the module was operated 15 h and cooled to ambient before testing.

requirements.text: In addition to provisions as described in paragraph 4.16. of this Regulation, the minimum red content of the light of a LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that the specified red content formula is met.
requirements.test_case: Measure the spectral irradiance of the LED module outside the device and compute the red content; pass if the minimum value per the formula is met.

requirements.text: The red content value of the LED module light shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometre.
requirements.test_case: Verify the red content calculation uses 1 nm spectral intervals.

requirements.text: The UV-radiation of a low-UV-type LED module, when tested outside the device, shall be such that the specified UV-radiation formula is met.
requirements.test_case: Measure the spectral distribution of the module outside the device and compute weighted UV radiation; pass if within the formula limit.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution and the colour of the light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be measured and checked for compliance after photometric stability (as defined in UN Regulation No. 48).
requirements.test_case: Operate the front fog lamp until photometric stability per UN R48, then measure intensity distribution and colour; all values must be within the R149 limits.

requirements.text: The UV-radiation of a low-UV-type LED module shall be weighted according to the values as indicated in Table A9-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the UV weighting function S(λ) used matches Table A9-1 values (interpolated where needed).

requirements.text: For front fog lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology (LED), the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the LED front fog lamp intensities after 1 min of operation (measured or calculated via the Table A10-1 ratio) and after photometric stability; all values must be within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For the front fog lamp, the luminous intensity distribution shall additionally be checked for compliance 4 seconds after activation, using the test point V, 2.5°D, as listed in Table A10-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at V, 2.5°D 4 s after switch-on and scale the stabilised distribution by the ratio; values must comply with the front fog lamp requirements.

requirements.text: In case the front fog lamp uses LED technology only, the front fog lamp is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured at 1 minute after activation and after photometric stability are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Verify that intensities measured 1 min after activation and after photometric stability both meet the front fog lamp limits.

requirements.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the minimum intensity requirements of the front fog lamp shall additionally be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at 4 seconds after activation as listed in Table A10-1.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity at V, 2.5°D continuously from 4 s after activation until stability; minimum values must be met at all times.

requirements.text: If the optional mark of the centre of reference is used, it shall be positioned on the lens of the front fog lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fog lamp lens and verify that the centre of reference mark, if present, is located on the lens at the reference axis.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. (lower legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height in normal ride attitude per 3.27/3.28; if < 425 mm, verify the lower legform test per 4.1.1 is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if within 425–500 mm, verify that either the lower or upper legform test chosen by the manufacturer is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if ≥ 500 mm, verify the upper legform test per 4.1.2 is applied.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper test, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the FlexPLI impactor per 6.3.1.1 and procedure per 7.1.1 were used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts across the bumper test area per 7.1.1; pass if MCL elongation ≤ 22 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1; pass if ACL and PCL elongations are each ≤ 13 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1; pass if the absolute tibia bending moment at all gauges is ≤ 340 Nm outside nominated relaxation zones.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths (relaxation zone) up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in those widths shall not exceed 380 Nm, unless a Contracting Party restricts the relaxation zone in its domestic legislation.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total ≤ 264 mm and the tibia bending moment in those widths is ≤ 380 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2; pass if the summed impact force is ≤ 7.5 kN at all times.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2; pass if the bending moment on the impactor is ≤ 510 Nm.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 ± 4 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Check test records show humidity between 10 % and 70 % and stabilized temperature 16–24 °C at test time.

requirements.text: The impact test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 percent.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test site surface is flat, smooth and hard with measured slope ≤ 1 %.

requirements.text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 6.2.1.1. and 6.2.1.2. shall be used for the test.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test specimen is a complete vehicle or a cut-body including the bumper assembly prepared per 6.2.1.1/6.2.1.2.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify via primary reference marks that the vehicle is in normal ride attitude and is either secured on supports or at rest with parking brake applied.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the cut-body to confirm the complete bumper assembly (fascia, absorber, beam, grille, lamps, sensors, plate holder) and other front structure parts are included.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Verify the cut-body mounting is rigid and its reference marks match the normal ride attitude.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify components with multiple fixed positions and perform the pedestrian impact tests in each fixed shape/position; pass if requirements are met in all.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Check the test log: the time between impactor removal from storage and test completion is at most 2 h.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area on the vehicle and verify that all selected target points lie within it.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor trajectory and verify that it is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Measure the velocity vector angles at first contact and verify a deviation of no more than ± 2°.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor roll and pitch angles at first contact and verify they are within ± 2° of vertical.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper, with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor bottom height at first contact with high-speed video and verify 75 ± 10 mm above the ground reference plane.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
requirements.test_case: Verify with high-speed video that the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Check with high-speed video that the impactor does not contact the propulsion system during rebound within the evaluation period.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor yaw angle at first contact and verify it is within ± 5° of the intended orientation.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, at the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.test_case: Compare the first-contact location from video or marking with the target point and verify a deviation of no more than ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: During contact between the flexible lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify with high-speed video that there is no contact with the ground or any non-vehicle object during the impact.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact velocity at first contact and verify it is 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.test_case: Check the tibia moment channels over the 30 ms before impact and verify that |M| ≤ 15 Nm.
